nom: The Ordinary Multi-Antioxidant Radiance Serum with Vitamin C and Ginseng

avis.texte: I purchased this because I work outside and wanted some extra protection. I really like it so far. I feel like it lightened some previous sun damage I had, and I dont have any new damage. My skin is super soft and glowing. I personally haven't noticed the fish smell noted in other reviews.

Okay so i love this serum and the company, my whole skin routine except for my cleanser and moisturizer are from the ordinary but anyway the serum is great but! It does smell like fish so keep that in mind

I love this brand so much however I can't get over the smell of this serum. It smells like a fish market- I thought the product HAD to have been tampered with and scrubbed it off my face the first time I used it. I gave it a second chance after seeing others (also think it smells awful but) continue to use it because it works well and the smell "dissipates in a short time". I can't get over the smell and will have to return it.

avis.titre: It's Effective as it is Smelly lol
avis.texte: Skin Profile: Dark/Deep Skin color, Normal/Dry skin Texture 4/5: The serum has a light consistency without being completely watery which I prefer. It also absorbs into the skin fairly quickly and leaves the skin feeling normal (non-tacky). I use this at night after washing my face and in the morning before putting on my sunscreen (I don't have to use moisturizer with my sunscreen). Effectiveness 4.5/5: While I did use this in tandem with Cerave's retinol serum, I have experienced more evenness and radiance when it comes to my skin-tone; unless you look closely at my skin my dark spots are not as pronounced. Scent 3.5/5: Although I do smell the undercurrent of fishiness that other people have commented on, it dissipates after a few seconds. It does not disturb my self-care experience, so I keep using it. The serum is fragrance free which is why I added the point five😅 Overall, 4/5: Does what it says...Yay

avis.titre: Rare 5 star review, would repurchase in a heartbeat
avis.texte: [I received this product complimentary from The Ordinary] I've been using products from The Ordinary regularly since about 2018. I keep coming back to this brand because the products are effective both in terms of cost, and actual results. I was really excited to release of this new serum. I am constantly looking for skincare products to help with skin dullness (especially with summer coming up) and usually these products cost me between $40-$80. I've been using this serum daily (morning and night) for three weeks and I have received compliments from friends on my skin's glow. This product is incredibly lightweight and does not leave my skin feeling sticky like some serums can. I've worn this under makeup and as long as I let my products sink into my skin properly, this isn't causing any of my complexion products to pill. When I run out of this bottle, this will be an automatic repurchase for me. My skin has become noticeably more radiant after daily application. I so rarely give out 5 star reviews for products but this one truly deserves it.

I've struggled with hyperpigmentation and stubborn acne marks for years, and I'm always hesitant to try new products—but The Ordinary's Multi-Antioxidant Radiance Serum blew me away. Within a few weeks of using it consistently, I noticed my skin looking brighter and more even-toned. Some of my older acne marks have started to fade, and my overall complexion looks much healthier and more radiant. The texture is lightweight and absorbs easily without feeling greasy, which is a big plus. It layers well under my moisturizer and makeup, and I love that it's packed with antioxidants to protect my skin throughout the day. This serum has definitely earned a permanent spot in my routine. Highly recommend for anyone dealing with discoloration or dull skin! Gifted by The Ordinary!
